args.sql: SELECT budgetallotusd, funds_util_pct, resource_gaps_usd FROM financials WHERE fin_ops_ref = 'OPS_0M990';

SELECT 
    REPLACE(REPLACE(budgetallotusd, '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS budget_num,
    REPLACE(funds_util_pct, '%', '')::numeric AS pct_num
FROM financials WHERE fin_ops_ref = 'OPS_0M990';

WITH disaster_dsi AS (
    SELECT 
        distregistry,
        (0.6 * ((10 * COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0)) 
              + (3 * COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0)) 
              + (2 * COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::numeric, 0)) 
              + (1 * COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric, 0))))
        + (0.4 * ((COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::numeric, 0) 
                 + COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::numeric, 0) 
                 + COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::numeric, 0)) / 3))
        AS dsi
    FROM disasterevents
),
catastrophic_ops AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.opsregistry AS operation_id, de.affectedarea AS location, dd.dsi
    FROM disaster_dsi dd
    JOIN humanresources hr ON hr.hrdistref = dd.distregistry
    JOIN operations o ON o.opsregistry = hr.hr_ops_ref
    JOIN disasterevents de ON de.distregistry = dd.distregistry
    WHERE dd.dsi > 15000
)
SELECT co.operation_id, co.location,
       ROUND(CAST(
           0.5 * (100 - f.funds_util_pct_num) 
           + 0.5 * ((f.budgetallot_usd - COALESCE(f.resource_gaps_usd, 0)) / NULLIF(f.budgetallot_usd, 0)) * 100
       AS numeric), 2) AS financial_health_score
FROM catastrophic_ops co
JOIN (
    SELECT fin_ops_ref,
           REPLACE(REPLACE(budgetallotusd, '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS budgetallot_usd,
           REPLACE(funds_util_pct, '%', '')::numeric AS funds_util_pct_num,
           resource_gaps_usd
    FROM financials
) f ON f.fin_ops_ref = co.operation_id;
